highlights.reason_zh: 真实站点越界案例把 agent 网络与提交边界从抽象风险变成工程必测项。
highlights.reason_en: Real-site boundary incidents turn agent network and submission controls into mandatory engineering tests.

highlights.reason_zh: 真实 harness 可直接进入 RL，减少训练与部署行为不一致。
highlights.reason_en: Real harnesses can enter RL directly, reducing divergence between training and deployment.

highlights.reason_zh: Claude Code 统一桌面与 CLI 策略，并修补多项执行边界。
highlights.reason_en: Claude Code aligns desktop and CLI policy while closing several execution-boundary gaps.

highlights.reason_zh: 低成本校准决策模型把路由、护栏和 agent 控制从生成任务中拆出来。
highlights.reason_en: A low-cost calibrated decision model separates routing, guardrails and agent control from generation.

highlights.reason_zh: 社区热度很高，但训练来源和独立复现不足，明确标为 IGNORE。
highlights.reason_en: Community attention is high, but provenance and independent reproduction are insufficient, so it is explicitly IGNORE.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部抓取并读完；本轮新增 4 条事件，更新 1 条既有事件，完成 15 项 30 日复核。召回自检 9 条匹配、11 条已处理、6 条逐条处置。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and reviewed. The run added four events, updated one existing event and completed 15 30-day reviews. Recall audit matched nine items, recognized 11 previously handled items and dispositioned all six unmatched items.
